name: Hemp Paradise
summary: Raise the hemp resort of your dreams in this unique city building and weed-growing game! In "Hemp Paradise," experience the thrill of farming simulator dynamics as you cultivate various marijuana strains. Explore and revel the beauty of paradisiac beaches, construct dope buildings to boost your farm and business. Join a cast of misfits characters in this exciting weed farming game, seeking their share of green happiness in your weed plant based game.
